crossRefs.note: put a covering of sealskin on it, spread a blue cloth over it, and put in its poles.
“They shall take all the vessels of ministry with which they minister in the sanctuary, and put them in a blue cloth…

translations.web: They shall put it and all its vessels within a covering of sealskin, and shall put it on the frame.
translations.bsb: Then they shall wrap it and all its utensils inside a covering of fine leather and put it on the carrying frame.
translations.kjv: And they shall put it and all the vessels thereof within a covering of badgers' skins, and shall put it upon a bar.
translations.asv: and they shall put it and all the vessels thereof within a covering of sealskin, and shall put it upon the frame.
